title: Constant clone assignment
statement: Let $D$ and $V$ be types, let $\Psi$ be a constraint satisfaction template on $D$, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with these data. For an assignment $a:V\to D$ and a natural number $M$, define its clone assignment on $V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$ by sending each pair $(v,i)$ to $a(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\Psi$ is a constraint satisfaction template on $D$
$E$ is a weighted constraint experiment for $D$ and $\Psi$
